page.notes: The left column in the middle (the four entries from תָּקְפָּת to לְ תִּקְפָּה) is printed in a faded, grey-tinted area; the Hebrew pointing and some Latin words there are only partly legible and are marked [?]. The Hebrew forms throughout are copied from a low-resolution scan, so vowel points and some consonants are uncertain. Several Hebrew forms are marked [?] where the letters could not be confirmed. Scattered specks and stains on the page are not printed text and are omitted. The running head letters are Hebrew numerals, read as printed with [?] for uncertainty.
